newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Koh Brothers expects better second half.
newsitem.headline: Koh Brothers expects better second half.

text.p: Construction group Koh Brothers Group Ltd said on Tuesday it expects to do better in the second half of the year.
In a note accompanying its first half results, the company said it currently has secured contracts worth about Singapore $698 million.
For the six months ended June 30 1996, the group reported a 27 percent rise in net profit to Singapore $2.36 million.
The company said the increase was mainly from building materials and equipment sector and profit recognition from development properties.
